Definition: from G1223 and G2059; to explain thoroughly, by implication, to translate:--expound, interpret(-ation).
BiblicalUsage: To interpret is to make plain what is not understood, and the word is used of tongues and of Scripture alike. Jesus interprets the Scriptures to the disciples on the road to Emmaus, Tabitha's name is interpreted as Dorcas, and the gift of tongues needs an interpreter to be understood.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe interpretation is a gift of love. A tongue no one understands helps no one, and the Scriptures no one opens stay shut, so God gives interpreters to make His word plain.
RelatedTopics: Scripture; Spiritual gifts; Knowledge of God
